_templateNotes: Copy this file to a new label file such as ab_crunch_001.json, then edit the paths, split, expectedReps, and reps.
Use issueIds from availableIssues. Use an empty issueIds array for a clean rep.
Files named _template.json or *.template.json are ignored by dataset:evaluate and dataset:optimize.
labelingGuidance: Side-view Machine Ab Crunches reps are the v1 full-form scoring target.
Front, oblique, or unknown-view Machine Ab Crunches reps may still count movement, but mark them scorable=false and do not label clean negatives for side-only form cues.
Count intentional crunch attempts with meaningful range of motion, including partial reps; do not count tiny pulses or aborted no-return motion.
Keep the same-side shoulder, hip, and knee visible so rep count and scoring signals are reviewable.
Label crunch depth, upright return, neck position, tempo, jerkiness, arm pulling, and hip shifting only when a clear side view supports the cue.
Label only visible faults; do not treat unobservable cues as clean negatives.
Reviewed scorable Machine Ab Crunches reps must use view=side; use scorable=false for front, oblique, or unknown views.

reps.notes: Clean rep or describe the visible form issue.

notes: Draft label template. Copy to a real label file, review timings/issues, then set reviewStatus to reviewed.

availableIssues.feedbackMessage: Crunch deeper — bring your chest closer to your knees.
Extend fully — return to the upright position.
Keep your neck neutral — avoid pulling with your head.
Slow down the crunch — control the movement.
Control the return — resist on the way back.
Move smoothly — avoid jerking the weight.
Use your abs, not your arms — keep the handles light.
Keep your hips planted — flex from your waist.
